name: linkedin-to-markdown
description: LinkedIn bookmarklet + userscript exporter for local markdown download.

scripts.build: npm run build:userscript && npm run build:bookmarklet && npm run verify
scripts.verify: python3 tools/verify_artifacts.py --infile src/li_export_md.js --bookmarklet docs/bookmarklet.txt --userscript userscript/linkedin-export-md.user.js --index docs/index.html
scripts.check: node --check src/li_export_md.js && node --check userscript/linkedin-export-md.user.js && python3 -m py_compile tools/build_bookmarklet.py tools/build_userscript.py tools/verify_artifacts.py && npm run verify
